title: Pope John III (61º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject of the(Ostrogothic) Kingdom of Italy, later a(Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity. Second pope not to use his personal name (Catelinus).

title: Pope Benedict I (62º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject of the(Ostrogothic) Kingdom of Italy, later a(Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity.

title: Pope Pelagius II (63º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Romanized Ostrogoth. Subject of the(Ostrogothic) Kingdom of Italy, later a(Eastern) Roman citizen. Ordered the construction of the Basilica di San Lorenzo fuori le Mura.

title: Pope St. Gregory I the Great (64º): Biography, Legacy & Medieval Church
sourceNotes: Subject of the(Ostrogothic) Kingdom of Italy, later a(Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity. Feast day 3 September. Great-great-grandson of Felix III. First pope to employ the titles Pontifex Maximus and Servus servorum Dei formally. Established the Gregorian chant. Also revered as a saint in Eastern Christianity, with a feast day of 12 March. Known as "the Father of Christian Worship". Known as "St. Gregory the Dialogist" in Eastern Orthodoxy.

title: Pope Sabinian (65º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject of the(Ostrogothic) Kingdom of Italy, later a(Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity. For the next two centuries, the Roman popes were all controlled by the(Eastern) Roman Empire.

title: Pope Boniface III (66º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject of the(Ostrogothic) Kingdom of Italy, later a(Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Greek descent.

title: Pope St. Boniface IV (67º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject of the(Ostrogothic) Kingdom of Italy, later a(Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity. Feast day 8 May. Member of the Order of Saint Benedict. First pope to bear the same name as his immediate predecessor.

title: Pope St. Adeodatus I (68º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity. Feast day 8 November. Sometimes called Deusdedit. First pope to use lead seals on papal documents, which in time came to be called papal bulls.

title: Pope Boniface V (69º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity.

title: Pope Honorius I (70º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity. Named a heretic and anathematized by the Third Council of Constantinople(680).

title: Pope Severinus (71º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity.

title: Pope John IV (72º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity.

title: Pope Theodore I (73º): Lateran Council — Complete Guide
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Greek ethnicity. Last pope from Palestine. Planned the Lateran Council of 649 but died before it could open.

title: Pope St. Martin I (74º): Martyrdom & Sainthood — Complete Guide
birthPlace: Perto de Todi, Úmbria, Império Bizantino
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity. Last pope recognized as a martyr; feast day 12 November. Also revered as a saint in Eastern Christianity, with a feast day of 14 April.

title: Pope St. Eugene I (75º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity. Feast day 2 June.

title: Pope St. Vitalian (76º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity. Feast day 27 January.

title: Pope Adeodatus II (77º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity. Member of the Order of Saint Benedict. Sometimes called Adeodatus, without a number, in reference to Adeodatus I sometimes being called Deusdedit.

title: Pope Donus (78º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity.

title: Pope St. Agatho (79º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Greek ethnicity. Feast day 10 January. Also revered as a saint in Eastern Christianity, with a feast day of 20 February. Pope during the Third Council of Constantinople(680), the sixth ecumenical council accepted by the Catholic and Eastern Orthodox churches.

title: Pope St. Leo II LEO Secundus (80º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Greek ethnicity. Feast day 3 July.

title: Pope St. Benedict II (81º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity. Feast day 7 May.

title: Pope John V (82º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Greek ethnicity.

title: Pope Conon (83º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Greek ethnicity.

title: Pope St. Sergius I (84º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was a Hellenized Syrian. Introduced the singing of the Lamb of God at Mass.

title: Pope John VI (85º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Greek ethnicity. The only pope who came from Asia Minor.

title: Pope John VII (86º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Greek ethnicity. Second pope to bear the same name as his immediate predecessor.

title: Pope Sisinnius (87º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject of the Rashidun Caliphate. Was of Syrian ethnicity.

title: Pope Constantine (88º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject of the Umayyad Caliphate. Was of Syrian ethnicity. Last pope to visit Greece while in office until John Paul II in 2001.

title: Pope St. Gregory II (89º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: (Eastern) Roman citizen. Was of Roman ethnicity. Feast day 11 February. Held the Synod of Rome(721).

title: Pope St. Gregory III (90º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject of the Umayyad Caliphate; last pope from Syria. Third pope to come from a Muslim country. Last pope to have been born outside Europe until the election of Francis in 2013. Third pope to bear the same name as his immediate predecessor.
